Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry

Record Class Obb

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry.Obb
Record Components:
centreX - the x-coordinate of the centre of the rectangle
centreY - the y-coordinate of the centre of the rectangle
angleDegrees - the direction its length points to, in degrees; 0 points right, 90 up
length - its size along its direction (a weapon's reach); above 0
width - its size across its direction; above 0
public record Obb(float centreX, float centreY, float angleDegrees, float length, float width) extends Record
An Obb (Oriented Bounding Box) is a rectangle that can turn: a melee swing's hitbox pointing towards the aim (GDD 1.5). Unlike an Aabb, its sides follow its angle instead of the axes.

  • Method Details

    • around

      public static Obb around(Aabb box)
      Creates the rectangle that covers exactly the given box, at angle 0: the hitbox of a trap or a contact attack, which never turns.
      Parameters:
      box - the box to cover
      Returns:
      a rectangle with the same area and position as the box
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if box is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the box has a width or a height of 0

    • corners

      public com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2[] corners()
      Returns the 4 corners of this rectangle, counter-clockwise: back-right, front-right, front-left, back-left, seen along its direction. The renderer draws them (F1 X-ray view) and the overlap test projects them.
      Returns:
      a new array of 4 new vectors, safe to change

    • overlaps

      public boolean overlaps(Aabb other)
      Checks if this rectangle overlaps a box, such as a hurtbox (GDD 1.5). Shapes that only touch on an edge do not overlap, as with Aabb.overlaps(com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry.Aabb).

      Separating Axis Theorem: two convex shapes do not overlap if their shadows on one axis do not overlap. For a rectangle against a box, the 4 axes to try are x, y and this rectangle's two sides.

      Parameters:
      other - the box to check
      Returns:
      true if they share some area
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if other is null
